.. py:function:: parse_number_ranges(spec: str, unique: bool = False) -> list[int]

   Parse a string such as:
       "6,7-10,15"

   into:
       [6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 15]

   :raises ValueError if the specification is invalid.:
